mc GEOGRAPHY No country other than the US exceeds 10% of net revenue; US about 29% of FY2025 net revenue (30% in 2024 and 2023) per 10-K note; five largest customers 21% (about $6.9B) of FY2025 revenue; no customer above 10%. Cross-border volume +11% local-currency in Q3 2026, gross dollar volume +7%, switched transactions +9% (Q3 2026 release). Long-lived assets: US $1,168M of $2,303M (51%).

mc EXPOSURE US interchange / Credit Card Competition Act (CCCA, S.3623, reintroduced 13 Jan 2026 by Marshall and Durbin): sits in Senate Banking Committee, no floor vote, not passed; sponsors failed to attach it to the GENIUS Act (2025) and the ROAD to Housing Act (Senate passed 5 Mar 2026 without it); Trump has publicly backed it and an October 2026 report says merchant lobbyists seek another vehicle (mc_ccca_congress, mc_ccca_paymentsdive; press, search excerpts). It would require issuers above $100B assets to enable a second, non-Visa/Mastercard network for routing. Sizing: US is about 29% of revenue; the share of US revenue exposed to credit routing is not disclosed: unsized, hypothesis.

mc EXPOSURE US merchant litigation (10-Q Note 14, filed 2026-10-29, pf_10q_20261029): accrued liability for US MDL cases $156M at 2026-09-30 (from $637M at 2025-12-31 after payments); Block and Intuit opt-out claims seek aggregate single damages above $5B, Mastercard says it cannot estimate potential liability; Rules Relief Class revised settlement preliminarily approved June 2026, final approval hearing November 2026; new April 2026 and September 2026 putative class actions on Damages Class and non-class merchants, district court ruled against the Damages Class plaintiffs in September 2026, appealed to the Second Circuit.

mc EXPOSURE UK / Europe interchange (10-Q Note 14): over GBP 0.5B (about $0.7B) of unresolved UK and Pan-European merchant damages claims; UK commercial-card collective action above GBP 1B (about $1.3B); two new UK collective actions served October 2026 for about GBP 1.5B ($2.0B) and GBP 0.4B ($0.5B); Portugal consumer claim about EUR 0.4B; Netherlands merchant claim about EUR 0.3B; European Commission information request (2024) on network fees to acquirers, ongoing. UK PSR: High Court rejected the Visa, Mastercard and Revolut challenge on 15 Jan 2026 and confirmed the PSR power to cap cross-border (UK-EEA card-not-present) interchange; level and start date not set per search results (interim cap dropped; PSR issued Specific Direction 23 on 30 Jul 2026, record-keeping and reporting of UK pricing decisions) (mc_psr_court, press, search excerpt). Revenue exposed to UK-EEA cross-border caps is not disclosed: unsized, hypothesis. Australia: ACCC debit-agreements case, liability hearing concluded June 2026, decision pending, fines possible.
mc EXPOSURE Russia: operations suspended since 2022; 10-K risk factor cites possible nationalization of the subsidiary and litigation; no revenue share disclosed as exposed.

mc EXPOSURE Stablecoins / GENIUS Act: law enacted 2025 (10-K Item 1 names it as the first major US crypto law and lists digital currencies as a competitive risk); rulemaking still open: OCC draft 2 Mar 2026 with final targeted for November 2026, Treasury proposal 17 Aug 2026, Federal Reserve proposal in the Federal Register 29 Sep 2026; statutory 18 Jul 2026 target missed (press, search excerpt, mc_genius_rules). Mastercard's own response is to join: BVNK (stablecoin infrastructure) acquired 3 Aug 2026 for $1.4B cash plus up to $300M contingent (10-Q, goodwill $1.3B), Global Money Platform with BVNK 15 Oct 2026, Stablecoin Security risk product 19 Oct 2026, about 130 crypto co-brand card programs and stablecoin flows in Mastercard Move (10-K). Effect on network revenue: no disclosed figure; disintermediation of card-based cross-border and remittance flows is a hypothesis, not sized.

mc EXPOSURE FX / travel: revenue is billed in many currencies; Q3 2026 net revenue +14% both reported and currency-neutral, so currency was neutral in the quarter; cross-border volume +11% local currency (the highest-yield line). USD strength, consumer spending and travel data not retrieved this lane (budget): gap.

mc NEWS 2026-10-29 Q3 2026 results: net revenue $9.8B (+14%), GDV $3.0T (+7% local currency), cross-border +11%, rebates and incentives +18% (release and 10-Q, filed 2026-10-29; citable from 2026-10-31).

mc NEWS 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-19 Global Money Platform with BVNK, Stablecoin Security product (company press releases, search excerpts; lead only).
